hints.title: Ordered Character Matching
hints.text: A subsequence must match target characters in strictly increasing index order without rearranging any characters.

hints.title: Greedy Character Consumption Invariant
hints.text: Matching the earliest available character occurrence in t that satisfies the current needed character in s leaves the maximum flexibility for remaining characters.

hints.title: Two Index Traversal Procedure
hints.text: Initialize index pointer i for s and pointer j for t at zero. Advance j across string t. Whenever s[i] equals t[j], increment i. At the conclusion, return whether i has reached the length of string s.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(T) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^T subsequences of t takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two pointers greedy traversal scans t in linear O(T) time and uses strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should write the clean two-pointer loop and discuss binary search with index tables for the streaming follow-up.
